poc_plan: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity to meet throughput guarantees and p95/p99 latency SLOs under representative production load.
Environment: 4x H100-80GB dedicated cluster (initial), option to expand to 8x if throughput shortfall; VPC peered to Alderbrook infra; KMS test keys provided.
Workload mix: 60% chat (avg prompt 120 tokens, gen 128 tokens), 25% reranking (short contexts, heavy model), 15% embeddings (batch queries).
Metrics to capture: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency per route, mean tokens/sec, GPU util, batch size distribution, queue depth, cost per 1M tokens, error rates.
- Baseline run: replay 48 hours of sampled production traces at 0.5x/1x load to verify latency profile and cache-warm behavior.
- Throughput ramp: increment qps in linear steps to identify saturation point; capture tail behavior when KV cache hits drop.
- Soak test: continuous 72-hour run at 80% of targeted sustained throughput to uncover memory leaks, KV cache fragmentation, and degradation.
- Burst recovery: inject synthetic burst (3x sustained for 10 minutes) to test autoscaling/burst capacity and fallback to quantized variant.
Representative prompts: curated set (50 templates) covering account opening chat, compliance summarization, price-reranking queries; will provide seed prompts from Alderbrook ops.
- p95 generation latency <= 350ms for 256-token scenarios in 95% of baseline windows.
- p99 < 800ms under sustained load with documented fallback behavior.
- Sustained throughput >= 300 qps for chat workload at target token length with GPU utilization > 60% and stable cost per token within 15% of estimate.
- No persistent errors > 0.1% and MTTR for transient failures < 5 minutes with automated fallback.
Instrumentation: Redwood Console dashboards, traces exported to Alderbrook SIEM, token-level billing reports, firehose of model traces (redacted) for QA team.
Deliverables: perf report (graphs + raw logs), recommended reserved GPU sizing, SLA draft with credit table, runbook for failover to quantized variant, cost projection.
Timing: 3-week POC (baseline + scale + soak), decision meeting week of 2026-04-12.
sla_negotiation_points: Guaranteed throughput band and commitment times (peak US trading hours 09:30-11:30 ET).
Tail latency SLOs (p95/p99) by route and token-length bucket; credits if missed, capped quarterly.
Burst capacity: explicit burst pool size and warmup expectations (seconds to resume previous latency).
MTTR expectations for node failover and cache reconciliation; playbook for degraded performance.
Data residency and audit controls spelled out; proof-of-logs export during POC.
Pricing: reserved monthly fee + usage overage; negotiation on minimum commit and scaling discounts.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial recommendation: 4x H100-80GB (dedicated cluster) sized for baseline; allow burst to shared spare pool up to 2 additional H100 equiv.
If throughput gap appears during ramp, escalate to 8x H100 and consider mixed fleet with 4x H100 + 8x A100-80GB as lower-cost fallback.
Quantization strategy: keep high-precision production model on H100, route low-priority traffic to int8 quantized variant for cost control and fallback.
Autoscaling policy: keep min-replicas pinned for guaranteed throughput window; enable rapid scale-up policy outside guaranteed window.
